March 14, 2024 - Minerva is a gold bullion vendor selling rare plans and recipes at discount, working for the Blue Ridge Caravan Company in Appalachia, in Fallout 76. She deals in gold bullion and is protected by her bodyguard, Tommy Ten-Toes and her brahmin Minos.
